cues.text: A colossal gas giant fills the starry void, its atmosphere swirling with indigo and azure bands. A brilliant, thin ring of ice slices diagonally across the blue sphere.
Massive, jagged asteroids drift in the foreground. High above, a tiny spark of light descends towards the planet, trailing a faint tail.
The colony ship plunges down, swallowed by the churning blue clouds.

beats.note: A massive blue gas giant planet dominates the view against a starry backdrop, featuring swirling bands of light and dark blue clouds. A thin, bright ring system circles its equator, angled diagonally across the frame.
Large, jagged chunks of ice and rock drift slowly in the foreground, forming part of the ring system.
A tiny, bright point of light, the colony ship, appears in the upper left, descending towards the planet and leaving a faint, wispy trail.
The ship approaches the thick blue atmosphere.
The ship plunges into the clouds and fades from view, swallowed by the gas giant.
